<document id="support-power-of-attorney">
PowerˆofˆattorneyˆIfˆyouˆhaveˆpowerˆofˆattorneyˆforˆaˆTallowbrookˆmember,ˆourˆAccountˆServicesˆteamˆcanˆaddˆyouˆtoˆtheirˆaccountˆasˆanˆagent.ˆ##ˆWhatˆweˆneedˆ-ˆAˆcopyˆofˆtheˆpowerˆofˆattorneyˆdocument,ˆsignedˆandˆinˆeffectˆ-ˆYourˆgovernment-issuedˆphotoˆIDˆ-ˆYourˆcontactˆdetailsˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆsendˆitˆEmailˆsupport@tallowbrook.exampleˆwithˆtheˆsubjectˆPowerˆofˆattorney,ˆorˆaskˆtheˆaccountˆholderˆtoˆmessageˆsupportˆfromˆtheirˆsession.ˆSupportˆcan'tˆreviewˆtheˆdocuments.ˆTheyˆgoˆtoˆAccountˆServices.ˆ##ˆHowˆlongˆitˆtakesˆAccountˆServicesˆrepliesˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdaysˆtoˆconfirmˆwhatˆtheyˆreceived,ˆandˆmayˆaskˆforˆmoreˆinformation.ˆ##ˆUntilˆit'sˆapprovedˆWeˆcan'tˆshareˆinformationˆorˆtakeˆinstructionsˆfromˆyouˆuntilˆAccountˆServicesˆhasˆapprovedˆtheˆdocument.ˆThatˆincludesˆfreezingˆcardsˆorˆchangingˆplans.ˆ##ˆIfˆtheˆaccountˆholderˆisˆinˆdangerˆIfˆyouˆthinkˆtheˆaccountˆholderˆisˆbeingˆexploitedˆfinancially,ˆtellˆus.ˆWeˆtreatˆthatˆasˆurgent.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="fees-schedule-plus-v2">
PlusˆplanˆfeeˆscheduleˆHereˆisˆeveryˆfeeˆthatˆcanˆapplyˆtoˆaˆPlusˆaccount,ˆeffectiveˆMarchˆ1,ˆ2026.ˆFeesˆareˆtakenˆfromˆyourˆmainˆbalanceˆwhenˆthey'reˆchargedˆandˆshowˆupˆinˆyourˆactivityˆfeedˆwithˆtheˆwordˆ"Fee".ˆ|ˆFeeˆ|ˆAmountˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆMonthlyˆfeeˆ|ˆ$5.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆOut-of-networkˆATMˆwithdrawalˆ|ˆ$2.50ˆ|ˆ|ˆInternationalˆATMˆwithdrawalˆ|ˆ$3.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆForeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆ|ˆ1%ˆ|ˆ|ˆCardˆreplacementˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆExpeditedˆcardˆshippingˆ|ˆ$25.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆOutgoingˆdomesticˆwireˆ|ˆ$15.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆOutgoingˆinternationalˆwireˆ|ˆ$35.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆIncomingˆinternationalˆwireˆ|ˆ$10.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆCashˆdepositˆatˆaˆretailˆstoreˆ|ˆ$3.00ˆ|ˆ##ˆDetailsˆYourˆfirstˆ3ˆout-of-networkˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆeachˆcalendarˆmonthˆareˆfree.ˆTheˆfeeˆappliesˆfromˆtheˆnextˆone.ˆNoˆplanˆhasˆoverdraftˆfees,ˆreturnedˆtransferˆfeesˆorˆinactivityˆfees.ˆTheˆmonthlyˆfeeˆisˆchargedˆonˆyourˆbillingˆdateˆandˆisn'tˆprorated.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="fees-schedule-premium-v2">
PremiumˆplanˆfeeˆscheduleˆHereˆisˆeveryˆfeeˆthatˆcanˆapplyˆtoˆaˆPremiumˆaccount,ˆeffectiveˆMarchˆ1,ˆ2026.ˆFeesˆareˆtakenˆfromˆyourˆmainˆbalanceˆwhenˆthey'reˆchargedˆandˆshowˆupˆinˆyourˆactivityˆfeedˆwithˆtheˆwordˆ"Fee".ˆ|ˆFeeˆ|ˆAmountˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆMonthlyˆfeeˆ|ˆ$15.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆOut-of-networkˆATMˆwithdrawalˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆInternationalˆATMˆwithdrawalˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆForeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆ|ˆ0%ˆ|ˆ|ˆCardˆreplacementˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆExpeditedˆcardˆshippingˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆOutgoingˆdomesticˆwireˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆOutgoingˆinternationalˆwireˆ|ˆ$10.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆIncomingˆinternationalˆwireˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆCashˆdepositˆatˆaˆretailˆstoreˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ##ˆDetailsˆPremiumˆhasˆnoˆATMˆfeesˆfromˆus,ˆandˆweˆpayˆbackˆATMˆownerˆsurchargesˆupˆtoˆ$10.00ˆeachˆmonth.ˆNoˆplanˆhasˆoverdraftˆfees,ˆreturnedˆtransferˆfeesˆorˆinactivityˆfees.ˆTheˆmonthlyˆfeeˆisˆchargedˆonˆyourˆbillingˆdateˆandˆisn'tˆprorated.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>
